reviews.review_msg: Shes rally passionate and a fair marker. Great prof would reccomend
Absolutely do not take EDUC100 with her. This is a warning.

she assigned reading responses and group discussions due biweekly (rotating). same assignments, tailored to new readings. It took months to get any grades back. things submitted in January were graded in March. If you made a mistake on your first paper, you wouldn't know and would make that mistake on each paper. you never knew how you were doing.

Took 3 months to get everything back. TA graded like it was a 400 level class and was very rude when asking about feedback. Prof also was useless as she had no idea what was happening. Both were VERY picky about APA style. GPA booster class into the hardest writing class I've taken. AVOID AYSUH AND TARA
Absolutely terrible. GPA booster class became a GPA reducer for me and everyone that took this class with this awful professor.

I would avoid taking EDUC 100 with this professor, as I was midway through the course before I got feedback on many of my items. This meant I could not improve my marks on my discussions or reflective assignments. Very nitpicky on format without considering the substance of what is written. Very terse when emailed about my concerns. Avoid.

I wish there was tags to describe how bad this class was. First off, it took the TA and prof took 3 MONTHS to get a single assignment back! It was only a 500 word reflective essay btw. There are still multiple assignments from Jan that havent been marked. Second, they were so picky about marking. If you're still reading this: AVOID THIS PROF!

Somehow turned one of the easiest class to one of the hardest writing class I've ever taken. Won't not recommend this prof to anyone. TA took 3 months to hand everything back. Absolutely unacceptable.

This prof somehow made an easy class that I took as a GPA booster, hard, she is way too caught up in APA formatting to actually assess the quality of the work, the TA is also an extremely hard marker and they take marks away for petty things. They started giving assignment feedback back once the semester was almost over, just horrible.

W. T. F. how is it possible to turn the easiest course in sfu into the most IMPOSSIBLE thing on earth. the marks are unfair and absurdly hard. the prof gives feedback on an assignment that was handed in 3 MONTHS AGO like bro how am i supposed to learn from my mistakes when the course is already over. smh if u have this prof just drop it.

Managed to make EDUC100W hard for absolutely no reason. Literally every other class had a better average than us and she marked assignments towards the end so we can't even work on whatever we did wrong over the semester. She and her TA were incompetent.

She did not mark any assignments. Just got back our first assignment a couple days ago and she marks real strict. There is no exact organization in her class structure and assignments, kind of hard to know what she wants in order to do well. Without feedback, we do not know where we are at. Took as an gpa booster, but Tara is smt else.

I did not learn anything in this course. She didnt hand back any assignments which meant we didnt know our grade at all. there was no way for us to reflect on feedback and improve for future assignments and it felt like i was just going through the course blindly. only nice thing about the class was she gave us a lot of time to work on assignments

Was excited to take the course based on reviews. Not sure if it's just this semester, but I really wish I didn't take it - or that I took it in class. Instructions for the assignments are so incredibly vague. Seriously, no indication of what the TAs are looking for. My academic writing is quite strong, but this course has been a nightmare so far

This was a distance education class, where your TA mainly runs the course. The class was fairly easy, though it can be time consuming and the instructions were not always clear. It is 50% portfolios and 50% group discussions, where you write 500 words for each, and no exams. If you can write an APA formatted essay, it is a GPA booster.

It's online so it's more about the TA; you never even meet Allan. 50% weekly portfolios of 500 words, 50% online dicussion. It's 1h worth of work per week. If you can write a basic essay with citations you'll get an A

Relatively easy and straightforward course. The course is composed 50/50 of short writing assignments and discussions which are due every week. The reading material is very accessible and simple, and the writing assignments and discussions are clearly laid out. I would recommend taking this course online, as I can't imagine in-person is as easy.
I found this class quite boring, but it was super easy, took very little time each weekm and fulfilled my humanities requirement so I don't regret taking it.
Very boring. Not the GPA boost it's mad up to be. Very long and tedious readings. No structure. Pass on this course and take it in class

Have heard AMAZING things about this prof and class HOWEVER the ONLINE/DISTANCE ED version of this class is HORRIBLE. This course was difficult and EXTREMELY time consuming. Look elsewhere for an elective or take it in-class

Allan is a wonderful prof, I cannot stress how great of a person he is. He's so chill and helpful and all of the assignments (paper/portfolio and a presentation) were so flexible; he lets you use your creativity. The other parts of the course were online discussions on canvas, so easy! Plus, no final! Take educ 100 with him!!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS ONLINE. It was a huge mistake. I took it online and my friend took it in-class both with Mackinnon and she loved him. But the online version was quite poorly done. Very difficult, unclear and no direction whereas in-class was the opposite. If you are going to take it online swap to something else... trust me
Great man to take upper division classes with but EDUC 100 was not as good as I expected. Material and text were hard to understand, assignments were long and boring, I would definetely not recommend
Best professor I've ever had at SFU... He'll go any length to help you, no matter what your problem is. Extremely down to Earth individual. Words cannot describe how great this man is.

She's one of the sweetest people you will ever meet. Her stories can go on for the entire class, but it doesn't even matter, because they are so entertaining. Educ 100 is definitely a GPA booster and I haven't said that about any class before. Strangely, my writing skills drastically improved after the final paper because of her editing. Wonderful!
Unclear grading criteria, spends way too long talking about useless things, but I guess the assignments are easy
didn't even get a good mark. too much for for an easy class

Extremely tough on her students. Not lenient about things even during covid where we are all stressed about remote learning. Tough marking and won't give students deadline extensions or exceptions even if they had a valid reason. This is supposed to be an easy entry-level education course and she made it extremely hard. Would not recommend it.

Literally, the kindest professor I have had at SFU. He truly cares for all of his students and I am happy I got to take the class with him. He is very receptive of class feedback and accessible/helpful outside of class. You will not regret having him as your professor. Tips: Do the readings he assigns and engage in class discussions. He's the GOAT

I've been lucky enough to have Cary as a prof for EDUC100W, 252W, and 352W. I can't recommend him enough. He is very responsive to emails and really cares about his students. One of the best profs I've ever had at SFU. The material can be a lot to digest and doesn't always make sense right away, but it is really interesting overall. 10/10
Not amazing, contradicts himself when asked on make up assignments. Marking system is not the best, gives not so great feedback on assignments.

Cary was such an engaging professor that seemed to enjoy teaching and talking with the students in the class. It was a pleasure to attend his class and I enjoyed it immensely. The homework he gives is extremely helpful and he is a very fair grader. Additionally, he gives very in-depth feedback. I would 100% recommend taking this class.

Cary genuinely wants his students to succeed and puts extensive effort into ensuring we feel safe and comfortable! His passion for teaching translates into the course w/ detailed weekly emails, clarifying videos, and fascinating personal insight in modules. His teaching style truly changed my education (for once, I felt valued as a student!). 10/10

Cary is extremely kind and understanding. EDUC 100W is an easy course, but it requires a lot of reading and a fair amount of effort. Cary truly cares about his students and is very passionate about the course topics. Highly recommend!
TA was bad, but the prof gave great and respected feedback on assignments. Clear grading criteria. Just small assignments throughout the semester. Recommend.

He is an amazing prof. Took him as a distance ed course so did not really get to know him too well. But he is super kind when it comes to him marking your papers, the TA was a bit rough. This course is mainly personal reflection so be ready to write, but it's really not too bad. Overall take this course with him if you get a chance to

Dr. Campbell is honestly one of the most amazing profs I've ever had. Many people take EDUC100W as a floater, GPA boost course but this has been one of the most enriching courses that I've ever taken. The course materials have definitely helped grow my own personal opinions and allowed me to grow morally. Cary is incredibly caring and accommodating

Cary is a fantastic prof! Learned so much in this class and had a lot of fun doing it. He makes his material so fun and interesting that the three hours in the class fly by. If you ever get a chance to have him you're lucky!!
Probably the best professor in education. Very easy going, fun, and caring for his students. Seminars are fun and eye-opening, and don't feel like the full 3 hours.

He is a very strange prof but pretty flexible about deadlines if you have a solid excuse. He is pretty caring towards the students compared to other teachers. If you have ADHD do not take this course because you will get lost in the sauce.
Best prof i've ever had! If you can take a class with her, do it!

Her class felt like a total joke. Although the content was very easy I feel I didn't actually learn anything about education and how to be a teacher. All we did was write poems in the woods and do improv. There was no real lecturing happening.

I took EDUC 100W with Celeste and it was AMAZING!!! She is my favourite prof and she cares so much about each student. The course allows you to be creative and demonstrate education in anyway. I enjoyed all the field trips and class discussions. Loved this class so much and I will miss it!

BEST PROF EVER! Bing is very outside the box, easygoing, friendly and approachable. His instructions/assignments can be unclear at times, but if you show up, ask questions and make an effort, you won't regret it. His lectures are half academic, half storytelling - always interesting. I would recommend everyone take a class with him!

He was very passionate about what we were learning. At first I didn't think I would enjoy the class but after a while I really enjoyed the subject and thought he did well. Sometimes he jumped all over the place but it was a nice easy class!

This class was the easiest A I've ever gotten in university. He is very passionate about what he teaches, even though sometimes it is unclear what he's trying say. He says the odd weird thing, but a very nice guy and good prof. Plus he's the easiest marker I've ever had.

This was one of my most favourite classes at SFU.  although he seemed spaced out at times, his thougths and ideas regarding education are VERY interesting and valid at every level. i learned 100 times more in this class then in any other class ive taken. definate gpa boost but its not about the gpa.. take the class its FUN!
Easy class! Great GPA booster, and expectations were clear

Rubric for assignments not always clear (i.e. the requirement for online discussions was three posts on different days instead of "2-3"). No feedback given for assignments was disappointing, could have at least added numbers to rubric. Last assignments were not given grades before final grades released, making calculating my own grade impossible.
zzzzzz. boring
He is the BEST lecturer in my student career life, so nice and kind; JUST CHOOSE HIM PLEASE!!!!!!!

Class was easy and Daniel was nice but the topics taught in the class were politically charged and highly skewed. The topics made me, as a student, feel forced to adopt an ideology and write my paper in using a certain ideology that I wasn't comfortable with, in order to satisfy what I believed the professor wanted to hear to get a good mark.

Daniel is a fantastic professor, he made an elective a very interesting class and expressed compassion when I experienced difficulties throughout the semester. As long as you give each assignment a good effort, you will do well, marks were generally very high.
THE BEST PROF AT SFU!!! He is very caring and understanding of his students. I highly recommend taking courses with him. God Bliss You, Dr. Chang!

Professor Daniel is amazing. He replies to emails promptly, gives great feedback, and truly cares about what he teaches. He will tell you what he expects, and he does it in a very caring and polite manner. A real legend during my short stint in the faculty of education. Helped me with my writing and critical thinking tremendously.

Awesome prof I love this man! Truly cares for his students and accessible outside of class (will get back to your emails quickly).You can tell he has a passion for what he teaches which is rare. Course was easy but interesting AND a GPA boost. 4 online discussions, 4 reading responses and a reflection paper. Seems like a lot but trust me, it's not.
The best prof ever, she responds back to emails instantly and gives genuine good feedback!

One of the greatest profs I've ever had. She genuinely cares about every student and accommodates to their learning needs as best as she can. Consider yourself lucky if you ever get the chance to take a class with her!
Amazing prof I've ever had.
She is a great prof! She gives great feedback on the weekly reading responses and there is no final exam for the course only a final paper! Definitely would take another course with her.
very good prof?very nice and helpful

Dr. Bai is an amazing teacher! She is very passionate about teaching and probably one of the kindest professors I have had. She really makes an effort to promote discussion, which only makes class more interesting.I would highly recommend taking a class with her.

Dr Maclean is an excellent lecturer. She inspires students and is very accommodating to classroom discussions. Topics covered in class sparked students interest which motivated students to do the readings and weekly written reflections . Research Essay was a great idea as we could research into any topic of education that we found to be of interest

Jerry is inspirational.  He's just an awesome prof.  Had him for EDUC 100, took it as an easy credit, and I thought the class was a cinch.  Ease aside though, take it for Jerry alone.  When he did not have me laughing (he's got a very comedic manner of teaching) he was provoking me to really THINK.  Few profs out there do this.  Highly recommended.
highly highly HIGHLY recommend this course. he was my favourite prof, I think every class at university should be like his classes. never boring,and always has a great answer to your questions

Kari was FANTASTIC.  She has an absolute passion for education and it clearly shows!  She is willing to go above and beyond her duties as an educator, and she is willing to listen to various points of view. If you want to be an educator, taking this class will change your perspective on pedagogy, from both the student and teacher perspective!

One of the sweetest professors I've had. He's super kind and accommodating, and he explains things in a way that's easy to understand. He's also funny, which made the class more enjoyable. The course was easy but still fun and inspiring. I'd definitely recommend him.

Kevin is so funny and his lectures are amazing. His class seemed hard at first, the TA was also a tough grader, but you will get used to the weekly Quick Writes and can easily improve by their feedbacks. We wrote 9 in total and 6 best were kept for marks. He also let us have cheat sheets for our midterm and final test. I would take his class again.

Love this man. He's so sweet and understanding, and his lectures are very easy to follow. His grading was very straight-forward and lenient (mostly the TA's grading that was ambiguous), and accepted all questions, answers and comments. Exams were very simple, and easy to do well on if all lectures were attended. 100% would take again.

The class was very straightforward, if you did what is requested of you then you'll do well. Lilach makes everything clear and is open to questions. LOTS of class discussions. Some topics were interesting some were very boring. Overall an okay class with simple assignments.
A genuinely nice person who cares about the students in her class.  Class is marked fair and as a Prof she is very understanding.  Highly recommend taking this course so long as she is teaching it.

Marela is like a friend morso than a prof. She is super kind and will discuss how the lecture material correlates to our everyday lives. Half the time you end up having deep discussions. Participation is important and highly encouraged. If you want a chill/vibey class, she is amazing. I took the class synchronously online.

Marela is one of the nicest professors you will ever have at SFU. Her 3-hour seminars can seem to drag on as she will talk about nothing for a while, but she is so nice and caring. She really cares about her students and seems like such a real person.

gpa booster for sure. One thing to know is that he likes to engage everyone in the class and ask everyone questions, if you sit there with a blank stare and he knows you haven't been listening this reflects in his marking. wrote some killer essays and journals and ended up with crappy marks, not impressed mark, not impressed
My favorite prof this semester. He's easy going and very approachable. Some work involved, but you can get by fine w/o the readings. Classes are always interactive and memorable.
SUPER prof. Easy going, funny, bright, involves everyone in the class. There is quite a bit of work but its easy and fun and he marks very fairly. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this class!

While I thought this class would be boring, Mark really opened my eyes to the world of education and really challenged me to think about the issues. It is not a class for slackers as you really do have to think about the issues and make insightful comments, but for anyone interested in teaching, I would highly recommend taking this course with Mark
quite tricky
a nice guy but not a nice prof...made educ 100 the most boring course ever...
Mark is really  a very nice guy!!!
No Comments
greeeaaat looking man...cute cute accent...warm, friendly smile.. how inappropriate of me to be even thinking like this .. good teacher tho, nice attitude and easy going

best prof ive ever had at sfu. she works hard to make sure every student does well and fully understands whatever she's covering. definitely a life-changing course, and meg was what made it life changing.

Meg is a goddess!! She gets hotter and hotter everytime I come to class! I am disliking the course very much, but meg is an amazing teacher. I assignments require lots of thought and she gives you feedback. All of the writing is about yourself, your own life and your own life. She said in class "your writing for yourself, not for me." Sums it up.
I disliked this course but liked  Meg a lot. She was really warm and motherly, but the fluffiness of the class wasn't my thing.

She is the best prof ever. You actually learn sth in this class. It's not like other classes that you just memorise and forget everything after final. She is caring, patient, and knowledgable. She makes you change. She makes you know yourself better.
Best Professor I've ever had - she changed my life!!!

It's a really great class, she's very nice and she does care about her students. It's a morning class but the time goes by really fast and her assignments are not difficult but requires a lot of thought.

Most caring prof I've had yet! She actually listens to what the students have to say and the way the marks are broken down shows that she teaches for her students to learn for themselves as opposed to just writing and saying what the prof wants to hear.
she's hot! course is okay too
Meg is smokin' HOT and her class is amazing... I LOVE YOU MEG!!
Truly cares about her students...awesome class
Should be compulsory to take this class, it rocks!!
He is by far the best prof ever. i took his class at SFU surrey and it was amazing.. I would highly recommend him.very fair and easy marker!!

Meguido Zola is one of the most inspiring people i've ever met. He is helpful, kind, supportive, and is interested in you as a person rather than seeing you as a student number. He is an amazing prof. TAKE HIS COURSE!!!!
He is amazing!
He was a good and fair prof. He helped those who needed it and didnt put up with any bull. Really makes you think outside the box!

Awesome prof, everyone hating on this guy clearly didn't do well in his class or is some book worm incapable of thinking outside of the box. It was a great class and I'd recommend it and the prof to anyone. A+++

Meguido is a very interesting character and can be both very kind and incredibly rude. He does choose favorites, but because the course work is so easy it really doesn't matter if you're one of them or not. easy GPA boost.
He's a great guy, his heart is in the right place, no I'm not hot looking. I enjoyed his humour.

Meguido is an incredibly wonderful professor. I come out of this class a happier and more confident person, hoping to become a teacher! Some may not get his sense of humor which can easily be mistaken as being rude but seriously, he's not from Canada, he finds sarcasm funny, deal with it! The books are wonderful and each class a joy to attend!
One of the best profs ever!!!

I found his course to be the most life changing course I've ever taken - and I've taken A LOT!His philosophy around making the students, rather than the prof., the center of learning was the first I'd ever encountered and now has become my own as a future teacher.Since that class, he has become my mentor and I've learned an INCREDIBLE amount.
The previous poster's lack of proper grammar and syntax may explain why she never picked up on Zola's belittling sarcasm.
It also helps if you are a pretty female!

I disagree with all the negative comments about this professor.  He is an extremely helpful professor and has inspired me to become the same kind of person and teacher, its not his fault that some students misread the instructions of assignments and can't comprehend an open-ended assignment!
I found that he really picks favorites.
I think he only liked certain people in the class, especially ppl who are expressive and extroverted.  I don't think he ever knew my name while it was just a 20 ppl lecture.

Meguido's class was interesting.  Definitly not how I pictured it.  We got to make our own journal to find our "true vocation."  I never found my true vocation, but had tons of fun making my journal.  Take his class if you want to learn differen
Total GPA booster...free ride and no pressure. Final is a group project..4 assignments, participation and attendance...easy "A"

meguido is a very interesting prof.  he has so many stories, and we talked about so many important issues in education.  the personal journal we were assigned was one of he best assignments i have ever done, although it was worth 50% of my grade.
No Comments
No Comments
Eccentric, offbeat, some find him rude and arrogant, others will learn a lot.
Embarassed me on the first day, simply for asking a question. Not helpful.
No Comments

Michael is absolutely AMAZING! He's very easy to talk to, and encourages the class to get to know one another on a more personal level. Very inspirational and open minded. Classes are engaging and fun to be in. Makes you really think about education and how it applies to everyday life. I'm considering changing majors because of him. Life changing.
i believe that michael is the most impactful and inspiring human. everyone should take a class with him.

Very inspirational Professor who is caring towards his students, willing to help support our learning whenever possible. He helped broaden my views on Education-as a way of life and that everyone have their own potential & Identity. He had taught us many valuable gems of Education and I will definitely take another course with him!

Wonderful seminar class! Michael asks students to dig into what they are personally interested in in relation to education. Very interesting in terms of material, as Michael brings forward his thoughts alongside the students'. A very caring and knowledgeable professor that makes university experience a little brighter.

I love this class! Really inspiring & changes the way you view education & what a good life means to you.  This is one of my fav classes + I'm in business.  He's the type of teacher every teacher should be.  Michael is a great person his positive energy just rubs off on you. Good grade regardless, so he focuses on you actually learning something

Michael is one of the most thoughtful and caring people I've ever met. He genuinely tries to reach out to every student and our 3 hour lectures flew by fast. Loved this class so much. Take it with him if you have the chance, you will not regret it!

Not only is it important to attend lectures it is also fun! Michaels lectures are engaging and he is enthusiastic about education and make you want to come to class to hear what he will say. He makes an effort to get to know each student and encourages participation in class. I wish I could take this course again.

Michael is an amazing prof. He's such a great conversationalist and his lectures draw from a vast collection of experience and knowledge. He really gets you thinking about the big questions. 100% approachable. Gets to know every student. Would take again.
He's the BEST professor I have ever had! Genuinely cares about his students, and he makes his class so interesting! 10/10 Would take again

Michael is absolutely amazing. He is so passionate and open-minded which makes his class fantastic. He genuinely cares about his students and he is very understanding of the stressful life of university students. Great class and great prof.
nice profs
Greatest teacher ever. If only all professors at SFU were like him.

One of the greatest professors. He is far from the other professors @ SFU. He makes you think critically about education and world view o.  Really emphasizes what a teacher is, he has made open my eyes to teaching, learning and the overall scope of education  Greatest teacher at SFU. Period. Would take him again

Michael is an amazing professor in addition to being an extraordinarily kind, caring and passionate human being. He always treated the students as equals and makes you feel as though you matter. His realness is comforting and allows you to be real as well. I recommend absolutely any class that Michael teaches.
The coolest prof ever,

She is an amazing prof! Super understanding and considerate of people's situations. However her grading scale can be difficulty so I don't recommend taking the class unless you're doing it over the summer by itself :)

This class was pretty disorganized, with the amount of due dates being rearranged and the lack of information given for some assignments. Very TA dependent. Is this course easy? Yes, but if you want a good grade, you have to write what you'll think the TA would enjoy and give all your efforts. The course is a bit overrated and is a hit or miss.

The course was pretty disorganized to be honest. Not much instructions were given on the assignments which made it confusing. Due dates were up in the air and the TA's gave out wrong information due to the disorginization. Also the grading scale is fixed. Anything 98+ is a 4.33...yes the course is easy but it is very hard to get perfect.
great teacher, loved her classes
amazing class.
amazing class.
super easy class. Writing narrative was where I lost some points, but other than that this class was super fun and interesting. The online discussions are great.
super easy class. Writing narrative was where I lost some points, but other than that this class was super fun and interesting. The online discussions are great.
I loved this class. It was super easy, with a few essays, two online discussions, and weekly polls. Michele was so sweet. I barely paid attention to this class and still got an A. Highly recommend!
I loved this class. It was super easy, with a few essays, two online discussions, and weekly polls. Michele was so sweet. I barely paid attention to this class and still got an A. Highly recommend!

Online pretty easy, weekly quizzes or polls (most weeks) + discussion posts week 4 and 7 + narrative essay. Easy to do well in class as long as you do the work, minimal effort can get you a good grade. She is nice and class is fun as an elective. Even though its a W course, not too much writing.

Online pretty easy, weekly quizzes or polls (most weeks) + discussion posts week 4 and 7 + narrative essay. Easy to do well in class as long as you do the work, minimal effort can get you a good grade. She is nice and class is fun as an elective. Even though its a W course, not too much writing.
Professor Schmidt is super chill and easygoing, and is really flexible with deadlines. Easiest course I've taken, minimum effort will still get you a good mark.
Really chill professor. Take EDUC100W with her if you have the opportunity, it's one of the best electives you can take for the sake of your mental health.
Really chill professor. Take EDUC100W with her if you have the opportunity, it's one of the best electives you can take for the sake of your mental health.

The course is well structured, with a module for each week's content. Ample time is given for writing assignments which are graded fairly. Her rubrics are super clear. You do have to be willing to share personal experiences for good marks on the discussions and the WalkAbout (a presentation of yourself). Quizzes are easy if you read the textbook.

TAKE. THIS. CLASS. Grading scale is brutal (98-100 is an A+) but absolutely doable if you put in the time. Literally the best professor at SFU. Super nice and caring and actually understands that you are a student and not a robot.
LIT CLASS TAKE IT !!!
great time with her in this course if you keep up with upcoming schedule

Easy class and honestly very interesting! Get ready to read as there is quite a lot, but its all focused on positionality and social construct, which I enjoyed. NOT FOR EVERYONE - if you can't see yourself reflecting and connecting with topics like this, I do not recommend, as I've seen this drag down GPA for those who lose interest.

Michele is an amazing professor, and she cares about her students a lot. I would highly recommend this class to anyone who wants to increase their GPA! The TAs mark easily—as long as you follow the rubric, you are good. You are guaranteed to get an A in this class! I took this course with her in the Summer of 2024.
The course is structured with weekly readings and the rubric for assignment/graded activities are clear. She is super helpful and happy to help solve an issues that you may run into.
Amazing professor, understanding and will help you succeed. EDU100 is a very easy course taking with Professor Schmidt

Michele is very kind. I'm not going into Education but took EDUC 100W to boost my GPA and It for sure did. The assignments and discussions were easy but they did get personal as we were asked to share about our lives. If you're open and caring then this class will not only be a breeze but it will be fun.

This class was great! I learned a good amount about the education sector and I appreciated the learning topics. As a Crim student, I took this as a Breadth credit and I totally recommend it. Participation matters and I would skim the textbook and lectures. The papers are easy if you follow instructions and the prof is so sweet and kind. TAKE IT!!

Michele was nice and obviously cared about students. She responded well to questions and comments and came up with interesting projects. She marks really easily too, so as long as you kind of follow the rubric and participate in class, you're almost guaranteed an A+.
The best professor I've ever had! Really cares about her students. This is the first class I've really genuinely enjoyed taking at SFU!
One of the best professors I have ever had at SFU. Enjoy having class with her.
Michele is definitely one of the best professors at SFU. She is well respected and cares about her students. Would definitely take more classes with her!

Best prof at SFU. Cares about her students, very approachable and helps them get the best grade possible. Very little workload and no final or midterm. She is very flexible with due dates and gives lots of time to complete assignments. Hands down the easiest course at SFU.

Michèle cares about her students and it is shown in the way she teaches. She is flexible with due dates and makes sure that the grading criteria is clear through her rubrics. This class is interesting because groups take turns teaching a chapter every week. She is willing to give extra credit. This class is chill and I am glad I took it. Easy A!

This is my third year at SFU and I can honestly say this is the first professor I have ever had who genuinely cared for her students. She is a very down to earth humble professor that is always approachable. I would definitely recommend taking EDUC100 with her and nobody else.

I enjoyed this prof, she made the class very enjoyable, was caring and made it a great learning environment, she really does care about her students' grades and is approachable. Take this class as an elective. You do have to attend all classes, but overall, she is very lenient and informed about education
This prof is really chill and caring. But she started getting tougher for the final paper.
Michele is an amazing prof. She made Education 100 a pleasant experience and found creative ways for us to demonstrate our learning. She's very approachable and is flexible with due dates.
she's okay

Michelle seems to be very nice and approachable. This class is a good gpa booster as there isn't much work to worry about per week. As long as you bother putting in the effort then it will reflect in your mark.

Michelle is one of the amazing profs I had this semester! She is so sweet and kind! To contact her about anything course related, so email her through CANVAS not outlook.
